spec.name: Orange Kitchen Hot Dog
spec.description: A plump hot dog with stepped golden split-bun halves, a browned sausage and a raised tomato-sauce zigzag. Rounded bread ends and exposed ivory crumb give it a warm, appetizing vanilla silhouette. Ground contact is y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Hot Dog. Long split bun curved via stepped geometry with browned sausage nestled between bun halves, mustard/sauce zigzag. Actual recipe ingredients: bun, sausage, tomato sauce. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
